# Critical flows

## Generate the codebook (static trace; not executed for this atlas)

1. An intentional source-vocabulary change is followed by `python3 scripts/generate_codebook.py`; the main guard dispatches main(), which parses --check and calls load_rows(). ([`README.md:140`](../../../README.md#L140), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:241`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L241), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:225`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L225))
2. load_rows() resolves the CSV relative to the script repository root, hashes its bytes, and parses UTF-8-with-optional-BOM CSV. Missing source, missing required fields, empty input, blank IDs, and duplicate IDs take explicit error exits. ([`scripts/generate_codebook.py:13`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L13), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:49`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L49), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:52`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L52), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:39`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L39), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:63`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L63))
3. render() builds the manual from loaded rows and their digest, including global evidence defaults and per-pattern sections. Without --check, main() writes UTF-8 CODEBOOK.md and reports completion. ([`scripts/generate_codebook.py:73`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L73), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:168`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L168), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:236`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L236))

## Check codebook consistency (static trace; not executed for this atlas)

1. The documented review command is `python3 scripts/generate_codebook.py --check`. It uses the same CSV loading and rendering path before entering the read-only comparison branch. ([`CONTRIBUTING.md:108`](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md#L108), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:226`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L226))
2. A missing codebook or exact-text mismatch exits with error status 1; stale output names the regeneration command. Matching output prints the pattern count and returns 0. ([`scripts/generate_codebook.py:230`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L230), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:231`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L231), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:232`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L232), [`scripts/generate_codebook.py:233`](../../../scripts/generate_codebook.py#L233))
3. Success establishes file consistency. It does not establish annotation agreement or pattern validity. Schema validation, import/export, independent annotation, and adjudication flows have plans but no implemented path to trace in this checkout.
